editorial.headline: Coconut Farming With a Clear Bali Reading
editorial.standfirst: A practical reading of coconut farming as a full agricultural cycle, open across business scales and not blocked for PMA registration in Bali.
editorial.body:
KBLI 01261 covers coconut farming as an integrated agricultural activity, not merely the act of planting coconut trees. Its scope runs from land preparation through nursery work, sowing, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activity when those steps form one continuous farming chain. It also includes planting coconut crops to produce seed in the form of nuts, together with nursery and seedling activity for coconut fruit plants.

That breadth matters for founders because the code describes the operating substance of a coconut agriculture business. A registrant under this activity is not limited to the final crop alone; the record expressly includes the upstream fieldwork and propagation steps that make coconut production possible. It is open to Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, and Besar scales, so the activity can sit under a very small farming setup as well as a larger agricultural enterprise, provided the registered business is still genuinely doing the coconut farming cycle described in the scope.

Nationally, the foreign-investment position is straightforward: the activity is marked TERBUKA, with a foreign ownership ceiling of 100%. In plain terms, the slim record does not show a foreign-share cap below full ownership for this activity. The stated source is Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021, and that is the only basis this editorial can use for the national PMA reading.

The Bali position is also clean, but for a specific reason. The province’s moratorium rule blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk KBLI for PMA island-wide on a permanent basis. This record, however, marks the Bali status as OK_or_HIGHER_RISK and says the OSS risk at Besar scale is Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi, so it is not blocked by that moratorium. The result is an unusually usable reading: this coconut farming activity is nationally open to PMA up to 100%, and the record does not show a Bali moratorium block for PMA registration today.
